product.title: Loza
product.body: Loza is an italic type family shaped by the mixture of historical models and calligraphic practice. Its lively rhythm and expressive forms create an energetic texture in continuous text. Originally started as an exploration of cursive construction, Loza developed into a collection of independent italic styles, each offering a distinct voice and working both individually and in combination.
product.seo_title: Loza — sharp dynamic italic font inspired by nature & calligraphy — Download free trials
product.seo_description: Loza is a dynamic display typeface inspired by calligraphy & flora. Sharp details, energetic rhythm and cursive forms convey freshness via type — perfect for sports, food & drink, organic brands, logos, web, packaging, editorial and more.

brand.title: Khorash Type
brand.body: Anna runs a small experimental foundry Khorash Type since 2025. The typefaces are available on Contemporary Type and Future Fonts exclusively. On Khorash Type Anna shares her thoughts on design process, inspirations and just nice pictures. Other than that Anna gives workshops about type and collaborates with type foundries on multi-script families. She enjoys partnering with graphic and industrial designers on custom projects.
